summary: The app wears your colour all the way through, and the website holds still while it loads

groups.title: Your colour
items: The app draws its mark in the title bar on the sign-in pages, and every colour now reaches the text, buttons and warning windows that had stayed cream.

groups.title: The website
items: The greeting and the Check page no longer jump when fonts load.
At Larger text on a phone, the bottom bar no longer covers lines or answers, and nothing is cut off or overflowing.
Keyboard focus lands on the answer heading after a quick check.

groups.title: Search results
items: A sweep of page widths proves Sentinel's marks never make a Bing title taller.

groups.title: Behind the scenes
items: A new check photographs every app page in four colours, light and dark, on a phone and a computer, and fails if anything is missing, hidden or still gold.
A new check lists every visual detail of the website and fails when one is missing, hidden, clipped or covered.
